name: IconButton
title: IconButton
summary: A round, icon-only button (`.iconbtn`) for compact actions such as menu, search, close, share and play.
whenToUse: Use when the icon alone is universally understood: menu, close, search, play/pause, previous/next, share.
Use in headers, drawers, players and toolbars where space is tight.
whenNotToUse: Do not use when a word would be clearer; use Button with a label.
Do not use for the main call to action of a section.

anatomy.description: A 44px circle, 1px hairline ring, transparent fill, one 20px line icon centred.

props.name: 'aria-label'
props.description: Accessible name naming the action, for example "Open menu". Required: the button has no visible text.

props.name: children
props.description: The icon, normally `<UiIcon name="menu" />`. Hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: tone
props.description: `dark` for dark surfaces (white icon), `light` for light surfaces, `solid` for filled Horizon Blue (the group's one primary).

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` is 36px visual with a 44px hit area; `lg` is 52px.

props.name: pressed
props.description: For toggles (play/pause, bookmark): sets `aria-pressed`. Omit for plain actions.

react.notes: `import { IconButton } from '@ism/ui'`. For labelled pills use `Button`.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Names the action: "Open menu", "Close", "Play ISM Radio". Required, short verb phrase in the user's language.

props.name: variant
props.description: `light` for light surfaces, `dark` for dark surfaces (header, drawer), `solid` is the group's one primary (Play).

props.name: selected
props.description: Toggle state (play/pause, bookmark). Reported as the selected accessibility state. Omit for plain buttons.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Menu button state; reported as expanded. Omit for plain buttons.

props.name: mirrorInRTL
props.description: Flip the icon in RTL (next/back arrows and chevrons).

variants.result: Base, styled for dark: white icon, rgba(255,255,255,.3) ring. Add .cr-iconbtn-dark for the hover tint.
On light: black icon, rgba(0,0,0,.22) ring, white fill; hover --gray-100.
Filled Horizon Blue (a player's Play). Counts as the group's one primary.
Static focus ring for specimens; real focus uses :focus-visible.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Always 44px tap target (`--tap-target`); `.cr-iconbtn-sm` keeps it with an invisible hit area.
Icons are inline SVG, 24 viewBox, `stroke="currentColor"`, stroke-width 1.8, round caps.
Icon meaning: ⌄ opens here, ↗ goes to another page, › drills into an app screen.
Only one solid blue icon button per group, and never next to a blue `.btn-primary`.
Focus: `outline: 2px solid var(--horizon-blue); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus)`.
do: Use when the icon alone is universally understood: menu, close, search, play/pause, previous/next, share.
Use in headers, drawers, players and toolbars where space is tight.
Always 44px tap target (`--tap-target`); `.cr-iconbtn-sm` keeps it with an invisible hit area.
Icons are inline SVG, 24 viewBox, `stroke="currentColor"`, stroke-width 1.8, round caps.
Icon meaning: ⌄ opens here, ↗ goes to another page, › drills into an app screen.
Only one solid blue icon button per group, and never next to a blue `.btn-primary`.
Focus: `outline: 2px solid var(--horizon-blue); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus)`.
dont: Do not use when a word would be clearer; use Button with a label.
Do not use for the main call to action of a section.
accessibility: Every icon button needs an `aria-label` that names the action ("Open menu", "Close", "Play ISM Radio").
Toggles (play/pause, bookmark) use `aria-pressed`; a menu button uses `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.
content: Labels are short verbs: "Search", "Close", "Share verse", "Next chapter".

html:
<!-- on dark (header, drawer) -->
<button class="iconbtn" type="button" aria-label="Open menu">
  <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 7h16M4 12h16M4 17h16"/></svg>
</button>

<!-- on light -->
<button class="iconbtn cr-iconbtn-light" type="button" aria-label="Share">…</button>
